messages.subject: FW: Caldervale Defence — first read
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia, Liam,

The Defence is in. No surprises. They admit the contract, the term, the figures and that Aldous signed the Acceptance Certificate. They deny the availability point but — crucially — they still haven't applied the Schedule 4 methodology, and they plead the £160k set-off without a single invoice. Their case rests on raw availability numbers we say are wrong. We'll plead a Reply hitting the methodology and the missing clause 16.3 notice. This strengthens, not weakens, our position.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
